claims.text: Buprenorphine/naloxone SL film induction: if dependent on heroin or other short-acting opioids, give the first dose when objective signs of moderate opioid withdrawal appear, not less than six hours after the last opioid use;
claims.quote: Patients dependent on heroin or other short-acting opioid products may be inducted with either buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film or with sublingual buprenorphine monotherapy. At treatment initiation, the first dose of buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film should be administered when objective signs of moderate opioid withdrawal appear, not less than six hours after the patient last used opioids.

claims.text: day 1 up to 8 mg/2 mg (in divided doses), day 2 up to 16 mg/4 mg as a single dose;
claims.quote: For patients dependent on short-acting opioid products who are in opioid withdrawal; on Day 1, administer up to 8 mg/2 mg buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film (in divided doses). On Day 2, administer up to 16 mg/4 mg of buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film as a single dose.

claims.text: if dependent on methadone or long-acting opioids, induce with buprenorphine monotherapy on days 1 and 2;
claims.quote: For patients dependent on methadone or long-acting opioid products, induction onto sublingual buprenorphine monotherapy is recommended on Days 1 and 2 of treatment.

claims.text: maintenance is generally 4 mg/1 mg to 24 mg/6 mg per day.
claims.quote: The maintenance dose of buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film is generally in the range of 4 mg/1 mg buprenorphine and naloxone to 24 mg/6 mg buprenorphine and naloxone per day.
